summary.default: Full-stack engineer specializing in AI-powered applications — from RAG pipelines and computer vision systems to production-ready web interfaces. Proficient in Python, JavaScript (React, Node.js), and REST API development, with a focus on integrating LLMs and machine learning models into real, usable software. Dual-certified by IBM in AI Engineering and AI Development.

variants.ai_focused: AI-focused full-stack engineer with hands-on experience building RAG pipelines, LLM-integrated applications, and computer vision systems. Dual-certified by IBM in AI Engineering and AI Development. Proficient in Python, LangChain, and modern frontend frameworks.
variants.backend_focused: Full-stack engineer with deep Python backend expertise — FastAPI, Flask, Django — and experience deploying LLM-powered services to production. Dual-certified by IBM in AI Engineering and AI Development.
variants.ml_focused: Machine learning engineer with practical experience deploying custom-trained computer vision models and RAG pipelines. Proficient in PyTorch, TensorFlow, YOLOv8, and LangChain. Dual-certified by IBM in AI Engineering and AI Development.

bullets.text: Architected a full-stack AI application using FastAPI and React, engineering a LangChain-Groq pipeline to automate exploratory data analysis and Python code generation.
Designed a server-side code execution engine using Python's exec(), capturing matplotlib figures as base64 images and streaming live visualizations to the React frontend.

Developed a single-service production build where FastAPI serves both the LangChain-powered REST API and compiled React frontend from one Uvicorn process, eliminating the need for a separate frontend server.

Built a RAG pipeline using LangChain, Chroma, and HuggingFace embeddings to ground cover letter generation in a curated knowledge base, achieving 100% retrieval precision across ML, Full Stack, and GenAI roles.

Engineered a custom eval framework measuring retrieval precision, grounding score, and output quality via LLM-as-judge (Gemini), delivering a repeatable scoring baseline to improve generation quality over time.
Secured the API layer with Pydantic input validation, prompt injection sanitization, and Flask-Limiter rate limiting.
Engineered a full-stack MRI diagnostic platform bridging Node.js and Python to classify brain scans using a custom-trained YOLO computer vision model.
Designed a child-process pipeline with custom Multer storage logic to ensure data integrity and 100% compatibility with computer vision decoders.
Developed a React dashboard with asynchronous state management, reducing result interpretation time by 80%.

Drove a 20% increase in enrollment throughput by re-engineering pre-screening workflows in collaboration with the principal investigator, identifying bottlenecks, redesigning intake logic, and reducing manual steps.
Cut data query resolution time by 30% by designing and implementing a structured weekly data review pipeline, enabling early defect detection upstream of sponsor audits.
Led end-to-end closeout of two Phase II studies by coordinating cross-functional action item resolution, regulatory reconciliation, and stakeholder sign-off ahead of all contractual deadlines.
